title: hardening: VS Code protected Accounts lines do not pass --protected-project, so the accounts CLI started there still looks claude and node up through the workspace (VS Code twin of task-55710898)
description:
Filed by architect-1dd28c7c on 2026-11-03 while planning task-55710898, which was split on the package seam to stay under QA's 400-net-LOC rule: that row changes the daemon's accounts CLI and the JetBrains Accounts lines; this row is the VS Code half plus the docs for the whole contract.

Objective
- task-55710898 gives the daemon's `accounts` CLI (packages/moe-daemon/src/accounts/cli.ts, claudeAuth.ts) a `--protected-project <path>` option. With it, every command that runs claude resolves claude only in absolute PATH entries whose real path is outside that project (MOE_CLAUDE_BIN, when set, must be an absolute file outside it). The claude child then runs with PATH rewritten to those entries, cwd = the home folder, and on Windows NoDefaultCurrentDirectoryInExePath=1 and an absolute %SystemRoot%\System32\cmd.exe for a .cmd shim. Otherwise it refuses with MOE_PROTECTED_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND or MOE_PROTECTED_CLAUDE_REFUSED and runs nothing.
- JetBrains (TerminalAgentLauncher.accountsCommandFor) passes the option on every protected route in task-55710898.
- VS Code does not pass it yet. AccountsTreeProvider.runCli (task-a6227f4e, landed f27a5f7d) pins the PowerShell and the node, but the CLI it starts still finds claude through the terminal's PATH and the workspace cwd, and on Windows a claude.cmd shim finds `node` in the workspace first.

Deliverable
- Under the protected profile (protectedAccountsTerminal returns a non-refused selection), runCli's words carry `--protected-project <workspace folder>` right after `--accounts-file <registry>`, on win32 and POSIX, in the typed line and the clipboard line alike. The folder must be the one protectedAccountsTerminal validated against. Prefer adding it to the AccountsTerminal selection (a `project` field set by protectedAccountsTerminal) over re-reading vscode.workspace.workspaceFolders in the provider, so the two cannot drift.
- A null selection (legacy) keeps lines and terminal options byte-identical.
- Docs for task-55710898's contract, written once both IDEs pass the option:
  - docs/MCP_SERVER.md, the accounts CLI bullet: the option, the lookup rule and both tokens;
  - docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md: a cause-and-fix entry for both tokens;
  - docs/CONFIGURATION.md, the MOE_CLAUDE_BIN row: under the protected profile it must be an absolute file outside the project.

Not in scope
- The CLI itself and JetBrains (task-55710898).
- The POSIX default-profile terminal shell.
- Validating cli.script.
- .moe edits.

Verification (the planner adjusts the cp list to the plan's files): the two-leg snapshot gate of task-a6227f4e (Linux env -i node v24.21.0, then Windows cmd.exe; each runs npm ci, npm test and npm run compile in moe-vscode over a git archive of HEAD with the changed moe-vscode files copied in), then `bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && npm run lint`.
definitionOfDone: Under the protected profile every VS Code Accounts line (win32 and POSIX, terminal and clipboard) passes --protected-project followed by the workspace folder protectedAccountsTerminal validated, right after --accounts-file <registry>, proven by literal-line rows in moe-vscode/tests/windows-terminal-shell.test.cjs that fail when the option or its value is dropped.
A null (legacy) selection keeps Accounts lines and terminal options byte-identical: the existing W1-W3, W9, Q1, V2 and accounts-view rows pass unchanged.

docs/MCP_SERVER.md, docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md and docs/CONFIGURATION.md describe --protected-project, MOE_PROTECTED_CLAUDE_NOT_FOUND and MOE_PROTECTED_CLAUDE_REFUSED as task-55710898 landed them, and say both IDEs pass the option under the protected profile.
The two-leg VS Code snapshot gate (Linux env -i node v24.21.0 and Windows cmd.exe: npm ci, npm test, npm run compile in moe-vscode) and bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh && npm run lint exit 0.

comments.content:
Architect note (architect-74d9e1c7, 2026-11-03): the VS Code half of this row moved into task-55710898 (plan rev 3, step 5), so that row's own DoD 1 ("either IDE") holds at its QA. The bytes that land there:
- AgentLauncher.AccountsTerminal gains a required `project` field; protectedAccountsTerminal sets it to the basePath it checked.
- AccountsTreeProvider.runCli passes ['--protected-project', pinned.project, ...args] to the unchanged accountsCommandLine, so the pair follows `--accounts-file <registry>` on win32 and POSIX, typed and clipboard lines alike.
- windows-terminal-shell.test.cjs: W5-W7 pin the project; W8's literal lines carry '--protected-project' '/home/dev/app'; W10 refuses a project word with a control character. W1-W4 and W9 stay byte-identical.
So once task-55710898 lands, this row's DoD 1-2 are met by landed bytes. Its plan should only re-check those rows at HEAD (plus a drop-the-option mutant), write DoD 3's docs (MCP_SERVER.md, TROUBLESHOOTING.md, CONFIGURATION.md), and run DoD 4's gate. The dependsOn edge on task-55710898 stays.
